query: create table if not exists public.chat_bans (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), room text not null, banned_name text not null, banned_by text not null, reason text default 'No reason given', expires_at timestamptz default null, created_at timestamptz default now()); create unique index if not exists chat_bans_room_name_idx on public.chat_bans (room, banned_name); create index if not exists chat_bans_room_idx on public.chat_bans (room); alter table public.chat_bans enable row level security;
